description: This file contains an end-to-end test script written in TypeScript using the Playwright testing library. The test simulates user interactions and network mocking to validate loading a previously processed PDF within the application, including setting up local storage, intercepting API calls, and asserting UI behaviors.

methods.name: test.describe
methods.description: Defines a test suite or group of related tests.

methods.name: test
methods.description: Defines an individual test case within the suite.

methods.name: expect
methods.description: Provides assertion methods to validate test conditions.

methods.name: page.addInitScript
methods.description: Injects a script that runs before any scripts on the page load, used here to seed localStorage and override fetch.

methods.name: page.route
methods.description: Sets up route interception to mock API responses for specific URL patterns.

methods.name: page.goto
methods.description: Navigates the page to the specified URL.

methods.name: page.getByRole
methods.description: Finds page elements by accessibility role and name for interaction.

methods.name: page.getByText
methods.description: Finds page elements containing specific text.

methods.name: expect.toBeVisible
methods.description: Asserts that an element is visible on the page.

methods.name: page.unroute
methods.description: Removes route interceptors previously set up.
